name: Economics (BA)
intro: Students are required to take ECON 203 , ECON 205 , ECON 303 , ECON 305 , ECON 317 , ECON 318 and four economics elective courses. Of the four elective courses (300 level or above) a minimum of two must be economics courses at the 400 level or higher.
